div.head: II Cn 33
div.ab: And gif hwylc man si, þe eallum folce ungetrywe, fare þæs cingces gerefa to, ⁊ gebringan hine under borge, þæt hine man to rihte læde þam ðe him on spræcan.
And gif hwilc man sy, þe allum folce ungetrywe sy, fare þæs cyninges gerefa to, ⁊ gebringan hyne under borge, þæt hine man to rihte lade þam þe him on sprecan.
Si quis homo sit, qui omni populo sit incredibilis, adeat prepositus regis et ponat eum sub plegio, qui ad rectum habeat eum omnibus accusantibus.
Be ungetreowum mannum. Gyf hwylc man sy ðe eallum folce ungetrywe sy, fare ðæs cynges geréfa to ⁊ gebringe hine under borge, þæt híne man to rihte lǽde ðam ðe him on specan.
And gif hwylc man si, þe eallum folce ungetrywe si, fare þæs cingces gerefa to, and gebringan hine under borge, þæt hine man to rihte læde þam ðe him on spræcan.

Concerning untrustworthy men. If there is anyone who is regarded with suspicion by the general public, the king's reeve shall go and place him under surety so that he may be brought to do justice to those who have made charges against him.
And if there is anyone judged untrustworthy by the community, the king’s reeve shall go and place him under surety so that he may be brought to justice before those who have accused him.

And if there is any man regarded with suspicion by all the people, the king’s reeve is to go thither and put him under surety, that he may be brought to do justice to those who bring charges against him.

(Von Vertrauens unwürdigen Leuten. B) Und wenn jemand ist, der allem Volke Vertrauens unwürdig gilt, so schreite der Königsvogt ein und bringe (sie bringen G A) ihn unter Bürgschaft, dass diese ihn denen, die ihn anklagen mögen, zur Rechtserfüllung stelle.

(Of untrustworthy men. B) And if there is anyone who is untrustworthy to all the people, let the king's reeve intervene and bring (let them bring, G A) him under surety, so that he may be brought to justice for those who accuse him.
div.note: G should supply ‘si’ after ‘ungetrywe’ (Ld ‘sy’). Liebermann compares I Atr 4.
B adds rubric Be ungetreowum mannum
ungetrywe si: si omitted in G
